title: cephalaria leucantha var. fragosoana
intro: Cephalaria leucantha var. fragosoana, commonly known as white hound's tongue or Fragoso's cephalaria, is a plant species within the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote relaxation, which is likely due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils. However, the health benefits and bioactive constituents of Cephalaria leucantha var. fragosoana require further scientific research to confirm their efficacy.
